title: Near critical interior dynamics in a model of state society interaction
summary: We study a normalized two dimensional competitive Lotka$-$Volterra system describing the interaction between state power and society power. Restricting attention to the positively invariant domain $[0,1]^2$, the analysis focuses on interior equilibrium dynamics where coexistence persists as the unique long run outcome. We show that when the interaction parameters approach the coexistence threshold $a_{12}a_{21}\to1^{-}$, convergence toward equilibrium becomes slow and trajectories exhibit prolonged transient dynamics.
